balanceOfPwToken(address).notice: Gets the balance of Power Tokens for a given account

balanceOfPwTokenDelegatedToLiquidityMini.notice: Gets the delegated balance of the Power Tokens for a given account. Tokens are delegated from PowerToken to LiquidityMining smart contract (reponsible for rewards distribution).

getPwTokenCooldownTime().notice: Gets the power token cool down time in seconds.

getPwTokenExchangeRate().notice: Calculates the internal exchange rate between the Staked Token and total supply of a base amount

getPwTokenTotalSupplyBase().notice: Gets the total supply base amount

getPwTokenUnstakeFee().notice: Gets the rate of the fee from the configuration. This fee is applied when the owner of Power Tokens wants to unstake them immediately.

getPwTokensInCooldown(address).notice: Gets the state of the active cooldown for the sender.

totalSupplyOfPwToken().notice: Gets the total supply of the Power Token.
